dualhotbar.settings.title: Dual Hotbar Settings
dualhotbar.options.scale.tooltip: Size of the second hotbar compared to the normal hotbar.
dualhotbar.options.overlap.tooltip: How far the second hotbar tucks behind the top of the hotbar, in the second hotbar's own pixels. 3 hides its bottom border. Full hides it until you swap, and leaves the rest of the HUD where it normally is.
dualhotbar.options.animation.tooltip: How long the two hotbars take to trade places.
dualhotbar.options.scrollToSwap.tooltip: Scroll while holding the Swap Modifier key (Shift by default) to swap the hotbars. Scrolling down and up turn the animation opposite ways.
dualhotbar.options.selectableSecondBar.t: Lets the selection move onto the second hotbar, in the ways turned on beside this. Its items are held by swapping them into the hotbar slot below.
dualhotbar.options.scrollPastEdge.toolti: Scrolling past either end of a hotbar moves the selection onto the other one. Needs Select Second Bar.
dualhotbar.options.doubleTapNumberKeys.t: Pressing a number key twice quickly selects that slot of the second hotbar; pressing it once goes back to the hotbar. Needs Select Second Bar.
dualhotbar.settings.overlapWarning: High overlap hides most of the second bar you select from.
dualhotbar.settings.selectionNote: Experimental: to hold a second-bar item, Dual Hotbar swaps it into the hotbar slot below. Other mods, servers and chest screens see the two swapped.
